analysis: Only CHANGELOG.md is in these units, with no executable code or patch hunks. I reviewed the head text, lines 601-1026. It describes these security-relevant behaviors, none of which I could verify against code. (1) Public model-demand stats (lines 605-614) add a public aggregate surface with a one-hour delay and k-anonymity thresholds (20 requests, 3 accounts). They need a threat-model entry; I raised this as a low finding. (2) App Attest dead-key rotation (lines 626-628, 631) has the coordinator request fresh attestation after repeated DeviceCheck failures, with per-machine rotation limits (1/hour, 4/24h) and a 6h backoff. It is stated never to revoke or deny serving. This relates to T-055 and T-057 (credential continuity, key-churn abuse) and TB-011. The next pass should check that rotated keys must pass the full enrollment, receipt, build-qualification and assertion path, and that the rate limits hold across machine merges. (3) Untrusted ready diagnostics (lines 635-640) match the TB-002 statement that diagnostics grant no authorization. `darkbloom report` reads the invoking user's credentials under sudo, so check log redaction and token handling there. (4) Macos27 App Attest candidate Apple device-attestation chain staging (line 630) must attach only after hardware trust. Not reviewed: any code behind these claims. This is a coverage limit, not evidence the changes are safe.

findings.detail: CHANGELOG.md line 608 describes publishing per-model hourly request and fulfillment aggregates on the Stats page, with CSV export and 24h, 7d and 30d histories. The listed controls are a one-hour publication delay, suppression of cohorts with fewer than 20 requests or 3 consumer accounts, and exclusion of suppressed hours from every resolution. The base threat model has no entry for public aggregate leakage of consumer activity. T-051 covers only profiler tables and admin exports. Risks to model: a consumer or competitor could use small cohorts, hour-boundary differencing between resolutions, or sybil accounts to infer or influence demand. Public outcome counts for capacity, timeout and error could also reveal fleet weaknesses. Fix: add a threat entry and assumptions for the public stats boundary, and verify the suppression and differencing logic in the code. This unit shows only the changelog text, so the implementation is not verified.
findings.title: New public model-demand statistics disclosure surface is not covered by the threat model
